mechanism.claim: A high-variation completed eight-hour BTC block with an unusually one-sided breadth of one-minute closes above versus below their own candle midpoints exhibits repeated micro-auction acceptance. When breadth agrees with block displacement, follow the accepted direction for eight hours.
mechanism.side: common strict sign of acceptance_breadth and completed eight-hour return
mechanism.why_distinct: HVIABR aggregates the sign of 480 independent one-minute close locations. DRCMR used one daily aggregate close location; wick candidates used aggregate wick lengths; record-discovery breadth counted running extrema. HVIABR uses neither their event sets nor controls and has no flow, volume, funding, OI, cross-assets, or fitted labels.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the causal variation tail selects volatile blocks while acceptance breadth requires direction to be repeatedly accepted inside constituent candles
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: three fixed UTC intrabar-acceptance onsets with eight-hour reservation are absent from Gross9

features.block: 480 exact coherent BTCUSDT bars_binance interval=1m rows [D-8h,D)
features.validity: at least 450 positive-range minutes; zero-range minutes excluded, no imputation
features.acceptance_strength_rank: strict-prior midrank of abs(acceptance_breadth) over at most 270 valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.70
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared log(close/open) minute returns over all 480 bars), strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.block_return: log(last close/first open) over eight hours
features.direction_confirmation: acceptance breadth and block return have one strict nonzero sign
features.onset: eligible now and immediately prior exact valid block ineligible; missing prior opportunity cannot trigger

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no acceptance statistic, rank, side, hold, clock, subset, or control repair.
